## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1/2/3/4/5/6 (Phase E slice): All 6 loop protocol DDs satisfied for preplanning Phase E touchpoint

## Testing Mode
RED (bundled: create test fixture + edit preplanning/SKILL.md — Gate 2)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md (Edit — Phase E loop block)
- tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh (Create)

## Loop Block Requirements
Inline block adjacent to b345 re-dispatch block: cycle declaration, oscillation-check Skill dispatch hard gate on cycle >= 2 (or OSCILLATION_CHECK_SKIPPED comment), HALT-vs-REPLAN exclusivity check, terminal REPLAN_ESCALATE:<phase-e-upstream>, mid-loop success exit, PROTOCOL_ERROR on invariant violation, trailing See: pointer to ab28 protocol doc.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh exists and is executable
2. All 6 DD scenarios pass (cycle-declaration, forced-failing, oscillation, HALT-vs-REPLAN, mid-loop-success, PROTOCOL_ERROR)
3. grep -q 'Current cycle: N of MAX_CYCLES' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md → found
4. grep -q 'See:.*protocol' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md → found
5. grep -q 'oscillation-check' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md → found (cycle >= 2 gate)
6. grep -qE 'REPLAN_ESCALATE:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md → found
7. Run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → PASS
data.title: Embed shared loop protocol block in preplanning Phase E with fixture
